About the data
These are the official LBMA London fixings (PM where applicable), the benchmark prices used to settle
physical bullion worldwide. Fixes are published on business days only, so for a weekend or holiday the
tool shows the most recent prior fix. Need today's live price instead? See the
spot dashboard
.
